hook.name: MiniBTCHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that fully replaces AMM pricing via BeforeSwapDelta. Buys (ETH→MiniBTC) mint tokens through a forward curve; sells (MiniBTC→ETH) burn tokens through an inverse curve priced against accumulated ETH reserves held by the hook. Liquidity additions are permanently forbidden; swaps require the swapper address encoded in hookData.
